readable describes the time fields (both present and distinct); a null playing is honest unknown — the provider labels it estimated. Comparing against the previous sample remains the documented refinement path.
The grid comes from the analysis track model, which owns ascending sourceTimeMs ordering; the function documents the precondition and bails only on an empty grid.
noUncheckedIndexedAccess makes m[2]/m[3] string|undefined at the type level, so the ?? fallbacks are index-access guards, not dead branches.

The header documents the live-verified layout (version, u32 reserved, u8 count at offset 5): count is the low byte of the claimed u32 in both readings and real crates carry zero high bytes. ScratchBeat4/5 verified 85/88 BPM.
f32 position + f32 BPM per marker is the format that decoded 85/88 BPM from live ScratchBeat files; a u32-beats layout would produce denormals, not those tempos.

remoteToDeckState is a message mapper: absent fields arrive as null and pass through as null (the reset), and the live path (DeckGenerationMapper) treats faders as physical mixer state that survives track loads. No code change.
First qualifying build event wins per P-35/P-36 so staged ramps span the full build-to-impact range; the in-code comment states the intent. Not a nearest-preceding lookup.
The reply socket now enables SO_BROADCAST before any discovery rung; directed/global broadcast sends no longer fail with EACCES (batch-03 fix).

openStream awaits only ensureArmed (chain-serialized) and its teardown/creation section is fully synchronous between awaits, so concurrent callers resolve last-writer-wins without interleaving. No code change.
stop() now flushes a registry save queued inside the throttle window before the sockets go down (batch-03 fix).
The powerMonitor resume hook installs once per manager instance (powerHookInstalled), so start/stop cycles no longer accumulate listeners (batch-03 fix).
The config/get seed now skips when the user has typed (scanTargetsTouched ref), so in-flight loads cannot clobber typed targets (batch-03 fix).
The magic config key is hoisted to one SCAN_LIST_KEY used by load/seed/save; the resnet hostnames stay as the documented owner-rig seed (see comment above the constant).

The final region's 4-beat tail is a bounded choice: the function receives no track length and the consumers tolerate it; the bpm hazard that fed this division is guarded at both boundaries (parseBeatGrid + tempoRegionsToBeats).
tempoRegionsToBeats throws on non-finite/zero bpm before any 60/r.bpm division, so count can no longer become NaN/Infinity (batch-03 fix).
